decision_rule_reachability.reason: All three outcome branches (SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID) are arithmetically reachable. SUPPORTS requires a COMPLETE treatment cell with task_success_rate>=0.6 (>=3/5) and parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 with a COMPLETE-and-VALID contemporaneous comparator; the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary (5/5 through real scorer) proves the ceiling is registerable, and the parent anchor (0/5 task success) shows the comparator floor. FALSIFIES triggers when at least one COMPLETE treatment cell fails to clear (parent realized this). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure (rule 1), partial cells (rule 2c), comparator confound (rule 2d), unattributable clearing treatment (rule 2g), or no complete treatment cells (rule 4). Threshold 0.6 over 5 episodes (k>=3) is fully attainable. Precedence 1..4 has no unreachable later rule: rule 2 executes only if rule 1 passes; rule 3 fires when loop completes with COMPLETE treatments but no clears; rule 4 covers the residual. Early stop at 2f is intentional and does not shadow comparator validity (comparator collected unconditionally at 2a).

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls were executed at design time as non-outcome-bearing canaries through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer with a REAL browser (Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome) against the SERVED task page (navigation repaired from parent's about:blank defect). PC-ORACLE-EPISODE fired 5/5 task_success (each episode: click #reveal-btn -> reveal TARGET-42 -> answer TARGET-42, target visible) proving the positive control fires and the full completion path is registerable. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stayed parseable 0.0 and task_success 0.0 (verification rejects non-JSON). B-RANDOM-ACTION (repaired navigation) achieved parseable 1.0 (valid JSON by construction) and task_success_rate 0.2 (< 0.6), with analytic P(>=3/5) ~ 1.15e-3 confirming the bar is effectively unreachable by chance. PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING achieved 10/10 for both models in the audited parent under identical grammar and probe, re-verified per cell at EXECUTE. No control is tautological (none contains the target answer supplied to the model) or structurally impossible. Distinct controls cover decoding, scoring liveness, null rejection, and chance-level task success.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA) is structurally live: it enumerates exactly the two matched actions admitted by the frozen action schema ('click' with 'selector', 'answer' with 'text') using the grammar's required key names. The audited parent's PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (10/10 both models) and comparator episodes (5/5 step-1 parseable both models) show this model class reliably emits parseable matched actions under constrained decoding. The success path (click then answer) is grammar-admissible: strchar ::= [^"\\] admits '-', digits, uppercase, so "text":"TARGET-42" and "selector":"#reveal-btn" are valid grammar strings. The PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary fired 5/5 through the real run_episode scorer with a real browser at design time, including the exact Appendix A.3 string-returning producer contract (prereg Appendix B). Provisioning feasibility of exact model artifacts is verified by parent receipts and design-time URL liveness probes. The treatment does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time: substrings absent). Self-attack acknowledged: the frozen GBNF admits schema-mismatched objects (e.g., answer+selector) that parse_action rejects, so liveness rests on empirical decoding behavior plus the rule that parseable_action_rate_step1 < 0.6 can never clear the bar — not on a syntactic claim.
